description: Game ground prop for ruined military outpost: four snapped wet wooden palisade stakes fallen in a low diagonal fan beside a breach, frayed splintered ends, dark weathered grey brown timber and subdued charcoal contact shadow. Compact flat debris, restrained pixel clusters and readable simple silhouette. Top-down three-quarter camera. Transparent empty background. No intact fence, no grass island, no dirt pedestal, no golden wood, no orange, no flame, no glow, no metal treasure.
